_comment: Autonomous live mode (python -m nuru live). The robot senses people with its own camera and microphone, decides with the rules in nuru/live.py (plan_* functions) and acts through the cue engine in nuru/cues.py. No operator input is needed.
_sense_comment: Perception thresholds. A face must be seen for confirm_s before it counts, and missing for lost_after_s before the person counts as gone. Faces further than max_distance_m are ignored (passers-by).
_listen_comment: Furhat ASR: we only use whether and how long someone spoke, never the words. listen_timeout_s is a hard cap on one listen call.
_mode_comment: The social feature: how many people are present. 1 person -> 'solo' cues (direct, repair by repeating). 2+ people -> the group profile (C3 Nuru cues: group first, pair, short gaze, bilingual, never insists).
_interaction_comment: What happens after the greeting. 'discussion' = the robot listens to the whole conversation, follows it in English and Kiswahili, contributes balanced opinions and invites quiet people (needs keys in config/keys.json; without them it still runs with scripted lines). 'questions' = Celestine's original Lab 1 flow (ask, listen, acknowledge; words are never used).

discussion._comment: Floor rules decide WHEN the robot speaks (nuru/discussion.py plan_floor); the model only decides WHAT. Times are seconds.
discussion._audio_comment: 'furhat' = robot microphone via the Audio Feed (enable it in the robot web UI: Settings -> External feeds). 'mic' = laptop microphone (mic_device = number from: python -m sounddevice).
discussion._camera_comment: camera_speaker: use mouth movement (nuru/avsd.py, needs mediapipe and a seat calibration: python -m nuru.avsd calibrate --furhat IP --seats A B) to link voices to faces. Set camera_flip to true if the robot attributes speech to the wrong person.

respond.en: Interesting point. Does anyone see it differently?
respond.sw: Hilo ni wazo zuri. Kuna mtu anayeona tofauti?

respond.en: There are good arguments on both sides here. What else should we think about?
respond.sw: Kuna hoja nzuri pande zote. Tufikirie nini kingine?

respond.en: Thank you. Let's build on that idea.

close.en: Thank you all, you shared many good ideas today.
close.sw: Asanteni sana, mmetoa mawazo mazuri leo.

discussion._gaze_comment: While listening: look at the speaker, nod every nod_every_s; after gaze_cooldown_s on the speakers glance at the quietest person for glance_s.

beckon.en: Come closer, I would like to talk with you.

greet_solo.en: Hello, I am Nuru. Let's have a short chat. There are no wrong answers.

greet_group.en: Hello everyone, I am Nuru. Let's discuss a question together. There are no wrong answers, and you can always pass.

repair.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Take your time.

repair_tech.en: Sorry, I could not hear properly.

release_solo.en: That's okay. Let's try another one.

closing_solo.en: Thank you for talking with me. Goodbye!

closing_group.en: Thank you all for sharing your ideas. Goodbye!

llm._comment: Chat models, tried in this order. Both use the OpenAI-compatible API. Tested 20 Nov 2026: MiniMax-M3 ~2 s, Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b ~1 s. List models: GET <base_url>/models. MiniMax China accounts use https://api.minimaxi.com/v1.
llm._strategy_comment: race: ask both models at once, use the first in 'order' (Groq) if it answers within prefer_wait_s, otherwise whichever answers. Groq is first because MiniMax timed out often in the 23 Nov robot test.

stt._comment: Speech-to-text. Whisper detects the language per utterance. No prompt: Whisper repeats prompts as fake speech. Transcripts in other languages than English/Kiswahili and known hallucinations are dropped (the robot still knows someone spoke).

appearance._comment: Expression, clothing colour and type from one camera snapshot at the start (nuru/appearance.py). mention: 'greeting' = address each person once after the group greeting; 'never' = only log it. Snapshot is not stored.

vision._comment: Vision model for appearance. Tested 20 Nov 2026: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash ~1.2 s (Groq had no working vision model).

led_discussion._comment: Discussion mode LED (RGB 0-255). Changes automatically with the state.

pauses._comment: Random pause range (seconds) between opening steps.
